playbooks.title: Migrate Hosting Account from KloxoNG to CWP (Control Web Panel)
playbooks.description: Complete migration of a hosting account from a KloxoNG server (AlmaLinux 9, MariaDB 10.6, vpopmail, qmail) to a CWP server (AlmaLinux 8, MySQL 8, Postfix/Dovecot). Covers: web files (rsync), databases (MariaDB dump with sandbox comment strip), email accounts (Postfix PostfixAdmin-style DB + Maildir), and app config updates (.env, wp-config.php). Tested migrating microrepair.net (1.6GB files, 2 databases, 24 email accounts, 164MB mail) in 2026-06-06.

steps.description: Inventory the KloxoNG source account: files, databases, email accounts, disk usage. Note SSH port (often 10022 on KloxoNG).
steps.command: ssh -p 10022 root@KLOXO_HOST 'du -sh /home/USERNAME/ && mysql -e "SHOW DATABASES;" | grep USERNAME && ~vpopmail/bin/vuserinfo -D DOMAIN 2>/dev/null | grep name'

steps.description: Install sshpass on KloxoNG (AlmaLinux 9) so it can push rsync/scp to the CWP server directly.
On CWP: create the system user and standard directory structure. Set password.
steps.command: useradd -m -d /home/USERNAME -s /bin/bash USERNAME && echo 'USERNAME:PASSWORD' | chpasswd && mkdir -p /home/USERNAME/{public_html,.conf,backupcwp,tmp,cwp_stats} && chown -R USERNAME:USERNAME /home/USERNAME/ && chmod 711 /home/USERNAME && chown USERNAME:nobody /home/USERNAME/public_html

steps.description: On CWP: add the account to root_cwp user and domains tables so CWP recognizes it.
steps.command:
mysql root_cwp -e "INSERT IGNORE INTO user (username,domain,ip_address,email,setup_date,package,backup,reseller,bandwidth) VALUES ('USERNAME','DOMAIN','CWP_IP','webmaster@DOMAIN',NOW(),'1','none','',0);"
mysql root_cwp -e "INSERT IGNORE INTO domains (domain,user,path,setup_time) VALUES ('DOMAIN','USERNAME','/home/USERNAME/public_html',NOW());"

steps.description: On CWP: create Apache vhost config at /usr/local/apache/conf.d/vhosts/DOMAIN.conf and reload Apache.
steps.command:
cat > /usr/local/apache/conf.d/vhosts/DOMAIN.conf << 'EOF'
<VirtualHost CWP_IP:80>
  ServerName DOMAIN
  ServerAlias www.DOMAIN
  ServerAdmin webmaster@DOMAIN
  DocumentRoot /home/USERNAME/public_html
  UseCanonicalName Off
  CustomLog /usr/local/apache/domlogs/DOMAIN.bytes bytes
  CustomLog /usr/local/apache/domlogs/DOMAIN.log combined
  ErrorLog /usr/local/apache/domlogs/DOMAIN.error.log
  <IfModule mod_suexec.c>
    SuexecUserGroup USERNAME USERNAME
  </IfModule>
  <Directory /home/USERNAME/public_html>
    AllowOverride All
    Options +FollowSymLinks
  </Directory>
</VirtualHost>
EOF
/usr/local/apache/bin/apachectl -t && systemctl reload httpd

steps.description: From KloxoNG: rsync the entire home directory to CWP using sshpass (skips .ssh). KloxoNG can reach CWP on port 22.
steps.command: sshpass -p 'CWP_ROOT_PW' rsync -az --exclude='.ssh' -e 'ssh -p 22 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password' /home/USERNAME/ root@CWP_HOST:/home/USERNAME/

steps.description: On CWP: fix ownership after rsync. If public_html was a symlink on KloxoNG it will be preserved.
On KloxoNG: dump each database with --no-tablespaces. CRITICAL: MariaDB 10.6+ dumps start with '/*M!999999\- enable the sandbox mode */' which MySQL rejects — must strip line 1 on import.
steps.command:
mysqldump --no-tablespaces --single-transaction DBNAME > /tmp/DBNAME.sql
sshpass -p 'CWP_ROOT_PW' scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password /tmp/DBNAME.sql root@CWP_HOST:/tmp/

steps.description: On CWP: create the database, create the DB user (match credentials from app .env/wp-config), and import the dump stripping the MariaDB sandbox line.
steps.command:
mysql -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS DBNAME;"
mysql -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'DBUSER'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'DBPASS';"
mysql -e "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DBNAME.* TO 'DBUSER'@'localhost'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
sed '1d' /tmp/DBNAME.sql | mysql DBNAME
mysql -e "SHOW TABLES FROM DBNAME;" | wc -l

steps.description: Read app config files (.env, wp-config.php) to get the exact DB usernames and passwords used by the application — create those exact MySQL users on CWP.
steps.command:
cat /home/USERNAME/.env | grep -E 'DB_HOST|DB_DATABASE|DB_USERNAME|DB_PASSWORD'
find /home/USERNAME -name wp-config.php | xargs grep -E 'DB_NAME|DB_USER|DB_PASSWORD' 2>/dev/null

steps.description: On CWP: add the email domain to the Postfix DB (PostfixAdmin-style). CWP uses postfix.domain and postfix.mailbox tables.
steps.command: mysql postfix -e "INSERT IGNORE INTO domain (domain,description,aliases,mailboxes,maxquota,quota,transport,backupmx,created,modified,active) VALUES ('DOMAIN','DOMAIN',0,0,0,0,'',0,NOW(),NOW(),1);"

steps.description: Get all email accounts and clear-text passwords from KloxoNG vpopmail. Use vuserinfo -D DOMAIN to list all accounts.
On CWP: for each email account, generate SHA512-CRYPT hash via Python3 (or doveadm pw), insert into postfix.mailbox and postfix.alias, create Maildir dirs at /var/vmail/DOMAIN/USER/.
steps.command:
python3 -c "
import crypt
def h(pw): return '{SHA512-CRYPT}' + crypt.crypt(pw, crypt.mksalt(crypt.METHOD_SHA512))
accounts = [('USER','PASS'), ...]
for user,pw in accounts:
  email = user+'@DOMAIN'
  print(\"INSERT IGNORE INTO mailbox (username,password,name,maildir,quota,local_part,domain,uid,gid,created,modified,active) VALUES ('%s','%s','%s','DOMAIN/%s/',0,'%s','DOMAIN',101,12,NOW(),NOW(),1);\" % (email,h(pw),user,user,user))
  print(\"INSERT IGNORE INTO alias (address,goto,domain,created,modified,active) VALUES ('%s','%s','DOMAIN',NOW(),NOW(),1);\" % (email,email))
" | mysql postfix
for user in USER1 USER2; do
  mkdir -p /var/vmail/DOMAIN/$user/{cur,new,tmp,.Trash/{cur,new,tmp},.Sent/{cur,new,tmp},.Drafts/{cur,new,tmp},.Junk/{cur,new,tmp}}
done
chown -R vmail:mail /var/vmail/DOMAIN/
chmod -R 700 /var/vmail/DOMAIN/

steps.description: From KloxoNG: rsync each user Maildir to CWP. KloxoNG stores mail at /home/lxadmin/mail/domains/DOMAIN/USER/Maildir/. CWP stores at /var/vmail/DOMAIN/USER/. Exclude courier-imap metadata files.
steps.command:
for USER in USER1 USER2 ...; do
  sshpass -p 'CWP_ROOT_PW' rsync -az --exclude='courierimapkeywords' --exclude='courierimapsubscribed' --exclude='maildirfolder' --exclude='autorespond' -e 'ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password' /home/lxadmin/mail/domains/DOMAIN/$USER/Maildir/ root@CWP_HOST:/var/vmail/DOMAIN/$USER/
done

steps.description: On CWP: final fixes — fix vmail ownership on transferred mail, reload Postfix and Dovecot, update APP_URL in .env to new domain.
steps.command:
chown -R vmail:mail /var/vmail/DOMAIN/
chmod -R 700 /var/vmail/DOMAIN/
postfix reload
systemctl reload dovecot
sed -i 's|APP_URL=http://localhost|APP_URL=http://DOMAIN|' /home/USERNAME/.env

steps.description: Verify the migration: check file count, DB tables, mail size, and Apache vhost.
steps.command: du -sh /home/USERNAME/ && mysql -e 'SHOW DATABASES;' | grep USERNAME && mysql postfix -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailbox WHERE domain='DOMAIN';" && du -sh /var/vmail/DOMAIN/ && curl -sI http://CWP_IP/ -H 'Host: DOMAIN' | head -3

playbooks.notes:
KEY LESSONS LEARNED from microrepair.net migration (2026-06-06):
1. KloxoNG SSH port is 10022 (not 22). Always check with nmap or by asking the user.
2. KloxoNG stores mail via vpopmail at /home/lxadmin/mail/domains/DOMAIN/USER/Maildir/ — NOT under /home/USERNAME/.
3. CWP uses PostfixAdmin-style MySQL tables (postfix.domain, postfix.mailbox, postfix.alias) — NOT virtual_domains/virtual_users.
4. CRITICAL: MariaDB 10.6+ adds '/*M!999999\- enable the sandbox mode */' as the FIRST line of mysqldump output. MySQL rejects this with 'Unknown command \-'. Fix: pipe the dump through 'sed 1d' before importing.
5. KloxoNG does NOT have sshpass by default on AlmaLinux 9 — install with: dnf install -y sshpass. This allows rsync with password from KloxoNG → CWP.
6. CWP server cannot reach KloxoNG on port 10022 (firewalled). Must run rsync FROM KloxoNG pushing TO CWP (port 22 is reachable).
7. Generate SHA512-CRYPT password hashes with Python3 crypt module — doveadm pw also works but may not be installed.
8. The app .env DB_USERNAME may be truncated to 16 chars (old MySQL 5.x limit). Always read .env and wp-config.php to get the EXACT usernames — they may differ from the system username.
9. Maildir on CWP is at /var/vmail/DOMAIN/USER/ (uid=101=vmail, gid=12=mail). Always fix ownership after rsync.
10. Exclude courier-imap metadata (courierimapkeywords, courierimapsubscribed, maildirfolder) when rsyncing mail — they are incompatible with Dovecot.

playbooks.title: Install ISPConfig 3 on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Full Perfect Server)
playbooks.description: Complete installation of ISPConfig 3 control panel on a fresh Ubuntu 22.04 LTS server. Includes Apache2, PHP 5.6-8.5 multi-version, MariaDB, Postfix, Dovecot, BIND9, PureFTPd, rspamd, ClamAV, Fail2ban, Roundcube webmail, phpMyAdmin, and Let's Encrypt (acme.sh). CRITICAL: Fix BIND9 forwarders before running installer or DNS check will fail. ISPConfig panel is accessible at https://HOST:8080 after installation. Tested on: server s1.technologixpr.com (192.254.73.46), Proxmox VE, 2GB RAM, 60GB disk.

steps.description: Verify SSH connectivity and check OS version
steps.command: ssh root@<HOST> 'echo OK && uname -a && cat /etc/os-release | head -4'

steps.description: Enable root password SSH login (PasswordAuthentication yes in sshd_config)
Update apt package lists
Upgrade all installed packages
Install screen, wget, curl (needed for installer)
steps.command: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y screen wget curl

steps.description: Download the ISPConfig auto-installer script
CRITICAL: Fix BIND9 forwarders BEFORE running installer to prevent DNS check failure
Launch ISPConfig installer in screen session with output logged to file
steps.command: screen -dmS ispconfig bash -c "bash /root/ispconfig-installer.sh --use-ftp-ports=40110-40210 --unattended-upgrades --no-quota 2>&1 | tee /root/ispconfig-install.log; echo ISPCONFIG_INSTALL_DONE >> /root/ispconfig-install.log"

steps.description: Wait for installer to load PHP then send "yes" confirmation to screen session
Poll log file every 2 minutes until ISPCONFIG_INSTALL_DONE marker appears (30-60 min total)
Extract ISPConfig admin password and MySQL root password from log
Verify ISPConfig port 8080 is listening (Apache running)
Verify all key services are running
steps.command: systemctl is-active apache2 mariadb postfix dovecot bind9 pure-ftpd-mysql

steps.description: Delete installer log files containing passwords for security

playbooks.notes:
KEY LESSONS LEARNED:
1. BIND9 forwarders MUST be configured before installer runs. The installer starts BIND9 mid-way and if forwarders are not set, the DNS check in the PHP installer fails.
2. Use screen to keep installer alive across SSH disconnects.
3. The installer asks "yes" confirmation â€” send via: screen -S ispconfig -X stuff "yes\n"
4. First run takes 45-60 min. If it fails and you re-run, subsequent runs are faster (15-20 min) because packages are cached.
5. ISPConfig panel: https://HOST:8080 (port 8080, not 80)
6. Credentials are printed in the log: grep -E "admin password|MySQL root" /root/ispconfig-install.log
7. Delete log files after noting credentials (they contain plaintext passwords).
8. ClamAV may fail to update during install due to DNS timing â€” not critical, it will self-update after BIND9 stabilizes.

playbooks.title: Install CWP (Control Web Panel) on AlmaLinux 8 / Rocky Linux 8 / CentOS 8
playbooks.description: Complete installation of CWP (Control Web Panel) on AlmaLinux 8, Rocky Linux 8, or CentOS 8. CWP is a free web hosting control panel (alternative to cPanel). Installs Apache (compiled from source), PHP multi-version, MariaDB, Postfix, Dovecot, ProFTPD, DNS, Webmail. Admin panel accessible at http://SERVER_IP:2030 (HTTP) or https://SERVER_IP:2031 (HTTPS) after installation and reboot. Tested on: AlmaLinux 8.10, Proxmox VE, 2GB RAM, 60GB disk. Installation takes 30-60 minutes (Apache compiled from source).

steps.description: Verify SSH connectivity, OS version, RAM and disk â€” minimum 2GB RAM, 20GB free disk, AlmaLinux/Rocky/CentOS 8
steps.command: cat /etc/os-release | head -4 && echo '---' && free -m | head -2 && echo '---' && df -h / | tail -1

steps.description: Check for conflicting services â€” CWP requires a FRESH minimal install. Stop any existing httpd/nginx/apache before proceeding.
steps.command: systemctl list-units --state=running --type=service | grep -E 'httpd|nginx|apache|cpanel|plesk|webmin|cwp' || echo 'No conflicts found'

steps.description: Download the CWP installer for EL8 (AlmaLinux 8 / Rocky Linux 8) using curl with redirect follow
Launch CWP installer in background with nohup â€” output logged to /var/log/cwp-install.log. Installation takes 30-60 minutes (compiles Apache from source).
Monitor installation progress â€” poll every 2 minutes. Installation is done when log contains 'CWP installation' or 'reboot' message.
Wait for installation to complete â€” grep log for completion marker. Re-run this check every 5 minutes until it returns output.
IMPORTANT: Reboot the server after CWP installation completes â€” required for CWP services to start properly.
After reboot (wait 2-3 minutes), verify CWP services are running â€” cwpsrv is the main CWP service.
steps.command: systemctl is-active cwpsrv && systemctl is-active httpd && systemctl is-active mariadb && echo 'All CWP services running'

steps.description: Open required firewall ports for CWP: 2030 (admin HTTP), 2031 (admin HTTPS), 80, 443, 25, 465, 587, 110, 143, 993, 995, 21, 20, 8080-8090
Retrieve the MySQL root password set by CWP installer
Verify CWP admin panel port 2030 is listening
Verify all key CWP services are running after reboot
steps.command: for svc in cwpsrv httpd mariadb postfix dovecot proftpd; do echo -n "$svc: "; systemctl is-active $svc 2>/dev/null || echo inactive; done

steps.description: Access CWP Admin Panel at http://SERVER_IP:2030 â€” login with root and the server root password. HTTPS panel at https://SERVER_IP:2031

playbooks.notes:
KEY LESSONS LEARNED:
1. Server MUST be a fresh minimal AlmaLinux 8/Rocky 8/CentOS 8 install â€” CWP has no uninstaller.
2. Minimum 2GB RAM required; 4GB recommended.
3. Use curl -L (follow redirects) to download installer â€” the centos-webpanel.com URL returns a 301 redirect to dl1.centos-webpanel.com. wget without -L will fail.
4. wget is often NOT installed on minimal AlmaLinux â€” use curl instead.
5. Run installer with nohup in background; it takes 30-60 minutes and compiles Apache from source.
6. A REBOOT is REQUIRED after installation completes â€” CWP services will not start without it.
7. Admin panel: http://SERVER_IP:2030 (HTTP) or https://SERVER_IP:2031 (HTTPS). Login: root / server-root-password.
8. CWP user panel (for hosting users): http://SERVER_IP:2082.
9. MySQL password is saved in /etc/cwp/.mysql_password after installation.
10. Tested on: AlmaLinux 8.10, 2GB RAM, 60GB disk, s1.technologixpr.com (192.254.73.46).
11. For EL7 (CentOS 7): use installer URL http://centos-webpanel.com/cwp-el7-latest instead.
playbooks.author: Jose Rodriguez Arroyo

playbooks.title: Install KloxoNG on AlmaLinux 8
playbooks.description: Complete installation of KloxoNG (open-source web hosting control panel, fork of Kloxo) on AlmaLinux 8. Includes Apache, PHP, MySQL/MariaDB, Postfix, Dovecot, ProFTPD, DNS. Admin panel accessible at http://SERVER_IP:7776 (HTTP) or https://SERVER_IP:7777 (HTTPS). Default login: admin / admin123 â€” MUST be changed immediately. Tested on AlmaLinux 8.

steps.description: Verify SSH connectivity, OS version, RAM and disk â€” AlmaLinux 8, minimum 1GB RAM, 20GB free disk
steps.command: cat /etc/os-release | head -4 && free -m | head -2 && df -h / | tail -1

steps.description: Set a valid Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) as the server hostname â€” required by KloxoNG
Update all system packages to latest versions
Install prerequisites â€” curl, wget, and other tools needed by the installer
steps.command: dnf install -y curl wget tar gzip

steps.description: Download KloxoNG installer script for AlmaLinux 8 / EL8
Make the installer script executable
Launch KloxoNG installer in background with nohup â€” logs to /var/log/kloxo-install.log. Installation takes 20-40 minutes.
Monitor installation progress â€” tail the log file. Check every few minutes.
Wait for installation to complete â€” poll for completion marker in log
Open required firewall ports â€” 7776 (admin HTTP), 7777 (admin HTTPS), 80, 443, 25, 110, 143, 465, 587, 993, 995, 21
Reboot server if required by installer (check log for reboot message)
After reboot, verify KloxoNG main service (kloxo) is running
steps.command: systemctl is-active kloxo && systemctl is-active httpd && systemctl is-active mysqld && echo 'KloxoNG services running'

steps.description: Verify KloxoNG admin panel port 7776 is listening
Access KloxoNG Admin Panel at http://SERVER_IP:7776 â€” default login: admin / admin123. HTTPS at https://SERVER_IP:7777
steps.command: echo 'KloxoNG Admin: http://SERVER_IP:7776 â€” login: admin / admin123 (CHANGE IMMEDIATELY)'

steps.description: Change the default admin password immediately after first login via Admin > Users > admin > Change Password
steps.command: echo 'Login at http://SERVER_IP:7776 and change password: Admin > Users > admin > Change Password'

playbooks.notes:
KEY LESSONS LEARNED:
1. KloxoNG installer URL for EL8 (AlmaLinux 8 / Rocky 8): https://kloxo.org/kloxo8/kloxo.sh
2. Server must have a valid FQDN set as hostname before installation.
3. Run with nohup in background; log to /var/log/kloxo-install.log.
4. Admin panel ports: 7776 (HTTP) and 7777 (HTTPS).
5. Default credentials: admin / admin123 â€” change immediately after first login.
6. User hosting panel: http://SERVER_IP:7778.
7. Firewall must allow ports 7776, 7777 for admin access.
8. NOTE: Some steps in this playbook were reconstructed on 2026-06-03 after the original was accidentally deleted. The core installer steps (download, chmod, run) were preserved from command history (IDs: cmd_1780125408472_zv8j, cmd_1780125450106_jnau).

playbooks.title: Install cPanel/WHM on AlmaLinux 8
playbooks.description: Complete installation of cPanel & WHM (Web Host Manager) on AlmaLinux 8. cPanel is the industry-standard commercial web hosting control panel. WHM admin panel at https://SERVER_IP:2087, cPanel user panel at https://SERVER_IP:2083. Requires a valid cPanel license (15-day free trial available). Installation takes 30-60 minutes. Tested on: AlmaLinux 8.10, 2GB RAM, 60GB disk, 104.152.185.78.

steps.description: Verify SSH connectivity, OS version, RAM and disk — AlmaLinux 8, minimum 2GB RAM, 20GB free disk, x86_64
steps.command: cat /etc/os-release | head -5 && free -m | head -2 && df -h / | tail -1 && uname -m

steps.description: Ensure server has a valid FQDN hostname — cPanel requires a properly set fully-qualified domain name
PROXMOX VMs ONLY: Create /etc/fstab if missing — cPanel health check requires this file. Get root device from 'df -h /' and filesystem type from 'findmnt / --output SOURCE,FSTYPE'.
steps.command: [ -f /etc/fstab ] || ( ROOT_DEV=$(findmnt / -o SOURCE -n) && ROOT_FS=$(findmnt / -o FSTYPE -n) && echo "$ROOT_DEV  /  $ROOT_FS  defaults  0  1" > /etc/fstab && echo 'fstab created' )

steps.description: Check for conflicting services — cPanel requires a fresh minimal install with no existing Apache, Nginx, or other panels
Download the cPanel & WHM installer script (~73KB) from the official Cpanel download server
steps.command: cd /home && curl -o latest -L https://securedownloads.cpanel.net/latest && ls -lh latest

steps.description: Launch the cPanel installer in background with nohup — logs to /var/log/cpanel-install.log. Takes 30-60 minutes.
Monitor installation progress — tail the log every few minutes. Look for phase indicators like 'Installing packages', 'Configuring', 'Done'.
Poll for installation completion — returns output when cPanel install is done
steps.command: grep -iE 'installation complete|cpanel.*installed|whm.*complete|Thank you for installing|all services are up' /var/log/cpanel-install.log

steps.description: Verify all key cPanel/WHM services are running after installation
steps.command: for svc in cpanel chkservd httpd exim dovecot named; do echo -n "$svc: "; systemctl is-active $svc 2>/dev/null || echo inactive; done

steps.description: Verify WHM port 2087 and cPanel port 2083 are listening
Access WHM (Web Host Manager) admin panel at https://SERVER_IP:2087 — login with root and the server root password
steps.command: echo 'WHM Admin: https://SERVER_IP:2087 — login: root / server-root-password'

steps.description: Complete the WHM initial setup wizard — set nameservers, contact email, and configure the server. cPanel user panel is at https://SERVER_IP:2083
steps.command: echo 'Complete WHM setup wizard at https://SERVER_IP:2087'

playbooks.notes:
KEY LESSONS LEARNED:
1. cPanel requires AlmaLinux 8 (or Rocky 8, CloudLinux 8, Ubuntu 20.04/22.04) — check supported OS list at docs.cpanel.net.
2. Installer URL: https://securedownloads.cpanel.net/latest — always use curl -L to follow redirects.
3. Run installer with nohup in background, log to /var/log/cpanel-install.log.
4. Installation takes 30-60 minutes — installs Exim (MTA), Apache, PHP, MySQL/MariaDB, Dovecot, BIND, ProFTPD.
5. No reboot needed after cPanel install — services start automatically.
6. WHM (admin): https://SERVER_IP:2087 — login: root / root-password.
7. cPanel (user): https://SERVER_IP:2083.
8. Webmail: https://SERVER_IP:2095.
9. cPanel requires a paid license after 15-day trial — purchase at store.cpanel.net.
10. Firewall ports: 2087, 2086 (WHM), 2083, 2082 (cPanel), 2095, 2096 (Webmail), plus standard mail/web ports.
11. Tested on: AlmaLinux 8.10, 2GB RAM, 60GB disk, 104.152.185.78.
12. PROXMOX VM FIX: If installer fails with 'missing /etc/fstab', create it: ROOT_DEV=$(findmnt / -o SOURCE -n) && echo "$ROOT_DEV / ext4 defaults 0 1" > /etc/fstab — then re-run the installer. This affects Proxmox-based VMs that boot without a traditional fstab.
